description: Disable x-anthropic-additional-protection activation: rename the CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_PROTECTION env-var constant in the 2.1.228 pooled name table (33 chars -> 33 chars, length field unchanged) so the lookup always misses and the server-side content-filter flag header is never requested.

patches.description: Rename env var in the pooled name table (33->33 chars) so the process.env lookup misses and x-anthropic-additional-protection is never activated

note: Old patch targeted a differently-serialized env table; 2.1.228 keeps the name in a kind-0x10 pool entry at ~10113200. Renamed name must stay exactly 33 bytes.
